description: Partially updates the role or scope of an existing Google Calendar access control rule. Provide at least one of role or scope; you can also choose whether to send sharing notifications. This operation modifies an existing rule rather than creating one.

calendar_id.description: Calendar identifier. To retrieve calendar IDs call the calendarList.list method. If you want to access the primary calendar of the currently logged in user, use the "primary" keyword.
calendar_id.human_parameter_description: The calendar you want to update. Use 'primary' to change your main calendar, or paste the full calendar ID for another calendar.
calendar_id.title: Calendar Id

role.description: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values are: "none" - Provides no access; "freeBusyReader" - Provides read access to free/busy information; "reader" - Provides read access to the calendar (private events appear but details are hidden); "writer" - Provides read and write access to the calendar (private events and details are visible); "owner" - Provides ownership of the calendar (all permissions of writer plus ability to see and manipulate ACLs).
role.human_parameter_description: The level of access to grant for this rule (reader, writer, owner, etc.). Choose the minimum access the person or group needs.
role.title: Role

rule_id.description: ACL rule identifier of an existing rule. IMPORTANT: The rule must already exist on the calendar - this action cannot create new rules, only modify existing ones. Use the ACL list action to find existing rule IDs, or use the ACL insert action to create a new rule first. Format: 'type:value', such as 'user:email@example.com' or 'group:group@example.com'.
rule_id.human_parameter_description: The specific sharing rule you want to update. MUST be an existing rule - use ACL list to find valid rule IDs. Format: 'type:value' (e.g., 'user:person@example.com').
rule_id.title: Rule Id

scope.description: The extent to which calendar access is granted by this ACL rule. Optional for patch operations. Must include `type` (one of: 'user', 'group', 'domain', 'default') and `value` (email address or domain name) for all types except 'default'.
scope.human_parameter_description: Who this rule applies to - either a specific user, group, domain, or everyone (default). Include this only if you need to change who the rule targets.

type.description: The type of the scope. Possible values are: "default" - The public scope; "user" - Limits the scope to a single user; "group" - Limits the scope to a group; "domain" - Limits the scope to a domain.
type.title: Type

value.description: The email address of a user or group, or the name of a domain, depending on the scope type. Omitted for type 'default'.
value.title: Value

scope.title: AclRuleScope

send_notifications.description: Whether to send notifications about the calendar sharing change. Note that there are no notifications on access removal. Optional. The default is True.
send_notifications.human_parameter_description: Choose whether to email people about the sharing change. Note: emails are not sent when removing access.
send_notifications.title: Send Notifications

name: acl_patch

display_url.description: Web URL to view or manage this ACL rule in Google Calendar settings.
display_url.title: Display Url

role.description: The role assigned to the scope. Possible values are: "none", "freeBusyReader", "reader", "writer", "owner".
role.title: Role

scope.description: The scope of the rule with 'type' and optional 'value' fields.
scope.title: Scope

type.description: The type of the scope. Possible values: "default", "user", "group", or "domain".
type.title: Type

value.description: The email address of a user or group, or the name of a domain, depending on the scope type. Omitted for type 'default'.
value.title: Value
